faq.title: Questions, answered
faq.a1: Yes. Arabic is the default language with perfect right-to-left layout, and you can switch to English at any time — even on the sign-in page.
faq.a2: Yes. Issued invoices are submitted to JoFotara automatically and the returned QR code is printed on the invoice.
faq.q3: Can I control what each employee sees?
faq.a3: Completely. Permissions go down to individual fields — for example, reception can see staff names and phones but never salaries.
faq.a4: Data is isolated per clinic, sensitive fields are encrypted, every change is audited and backups are encrypted daily.
faq.q5: Can I move from another system?
faq.a5: Yes. We help you import patients and opening balances so you can start with your history in place.
faq.q6: Do I need to install anything?
faq.a6: No. ElDental runs in the browser on any computer, tablet or phone, and patients can install the portal like an app.

about.title: We build software dentists are proud to use
about.subtitle: ElDental started inside real clinics. We watched receptionists juggle paper calendars, dentists re-type notes and accountants rebuild the books every month — and decided it should be better.
about.missionBody: Give every dental clinic in the region a calm, connected workday: from the first phone call to the final journal entry, without spreadsheets, double entry or guesswork.
about.storyBody: We spent years building healthcare software for clinics in Jordan. ElDental is the result of everything we learned — rebuilt from scratch for dentistry, with Arabic first, security by design and accounting that actually balances.

v1.title: Clinics first
v1.body: Every screen is designed around a real task, timed in a real clinic.

v2.title: Arabic by default
v2.body: Right-to-left isn't a translation layer for us — it's where we start.

v3.title: Trust is earned
v3.body: Patient data is sacred. We encrypt it, isolate it and audit every access.

v4.title: Numbers that add up
v4.body: Every financial event is a balanced journal entry. Always.

securityPage.title: Your patients trust you. You can trust us.
securityPage.subtitle: Security isn't a feature we added — it's how ElDental is built, from the database to the browser.

i1.title: Strict clinic isolation
i1.body: Every record belongs to one clinic and is filtered in the data layer. Automated tests prove clinics can never see each other's data.

i2.title: Encryption everywhere
i2.body: TLS in transit; national IDs, bank details and integration secrets encrypted at rest with AES-256.

i3.title: Field-level permissions
i3.body: Hidden fields never leave the server. Masked values are masked before they reach the browser.

i4.title: Complete audit trail
i4.body: Who changed what, when and from where — with before and after values — for every clinical and financial record.

i5.title: Modern authentication
i5.body: Short-lived tokens, rotating sessions with theft detection, lockout protection and two-factor authentication.

i6.title: Encrypted backups
i6.body: Daily encrypted off-site backups with regular restore drills. Your data is never sent through chat apps.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information ElDental processes, why, and the choices you have. Clinics remain the controllers of their patients' data; ElDental processes it on their behalf.
privacy.s1b: Account information for clinic staff (name, email, phone), clinic configuration, and the patient, clinical and financial records that clinics enter. We also keep security and usage logs without the values you type into forms.
privacy.s2b: To provide the service, keep it secure, send the notifications clinics enable (such as appointment reminders), and improve reliability. We never sell personal data.
privacy.s3b: Data is isolated per clinic, encrypted in transit and, for sensitive fields, at rest. Access is restricted by role and field-level permissions, and every change is audited.
privacy.s4b: Clinical and financial records are kept as long as the clinic's account is active and as required by law. Logs are kept for limited periods and then deleted automatically.
privacy.s5b: Patients should contact their clinic to access or correct their records. Clinic users can contact us to exercise their rights regarding their account.
privacy.s6b: Questions about privacy? Write to us through the contact page and our team will respond.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms govern the use of ElDental by clinics and their staff. By creating an account you agree to them on behalf of your clinic.
terms.s1b: ElDental provides cloud software for scheduling, clinical records, billing, accounting, HR and patient communication. Features depend on your plan.
terms.s2b: You are responsible for the accuracy of the data you enter, for granting permissions appropriately and for keeping your login credentials secure.
terms.s3b: Plans are billed monthly or yearly in advance. If a subscription lapses, the clinic switches to read-only mode until it is renewed — your data is never deleted for non-payment.
terms.s4b: Your clinic owns its data. You can export it at any time, and we will help you move it if you decide to leave.
terms.s5b: We work hard to keep ElDental available around the clock and announce planned maintenance in advance.
terms.s6b: We may update these terms and will notify clinic owners of material changes before they take effect.
